description: FREE keyless x402 settlement check on Base: pass a tx hash plus payto (and optionally expect, in USDC). Dual-RPC reads the receipt, decodes USDC Transfers and returns SETTLED | UNDERPAID | WRONG_RECIPIENT | NO_TRANSFER | REVERTED | NOT_FOUND. Binds to the payTo you supply; resolving the payTo from a live 402 url is the paid x402_receipt_verify.

expect.description: optional: advertised amount in USDC dollars (e.g. 0.004)

payto.description: 0x payTo address the payment should have reached

name: x402_receipt_verify_preview
